notes.title: Glassbreakers - Development Blog #4
notes.content:
Snuggle up, Squad! It's your friendly neighborhood community manager, Kristen! Today, I am excited to reveal the second previously unrevealed Champion coming to Glassbreakers: Djain, the Gambler! To get to know our beloved Gambler better, I spoke with our talented writer, Shauna, and our design director, Chris Bourassa, to get a sense of who Djain is, their motivations, and what they bring to Glassbreakers.

The Diary of Djain
A smirk curls on Djain's lips as they slowly roll a set of dice between each finger. "You're in too deep," Djain says, "but I can make you an offer you simply can't refuse."

Meet Djain: an immortal, silver-tongued devil who loves games of chance and Faustian bargains. You've never met them before. Not in Moss or any bedtime story you were told. Perhaps you heard of them in whispers—half-forgotten tales of a trickster who showed up when things have gone awry... or very, very interesting.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/a3f01b6a31ed61ba43df7e31f61d11839097829c.png"]

Djain is a Starthing, a mysterious, fairy-like being dwelling on the edge of myth and legend. If you played either Moss games, you may recall Aderyn, who gave players their first glimpse at Starthings. While Aderyn was bound by a curse and caught in a rather unique position, Djain feels little empathy or interest in the concerns of mere mortals. For Djain, the rules of life and death do not apply. After all, a mortal's lifespan is but a blink for Djain.


The Devil You Don't Know
When we set out to build the roster for Glassbreakers, we knew we wanted a wide spectrum of personalities, from the purest of hearts to the villainous. Djain is the villain you love to hate, or hate to love.

Djain stands out narratively because they operate from a different frame of reference than any other Champions. While mortals are concerned about winning, losing, or surviving another day, Djain doesn't have the same existential weight that the awareness of mortality brings.

Djain may also (👀) have some history with other Champions. Without spoiling too much, there are a few rare VO lines between Djain and Brel, hinting at a murky, complicated history. In a way, it feels as if Djain has always been behind the scenes, playing games and pulling at threads, and only now is stepping out from the shadows.

We look forward to you finding the other narrative Easter-eggs sprinkled throughout. Let's just say... some games are never finished.


The Making of a Trickster
From the beginning, we wanted Djain to feel different. After all, they are a slick, silver-tongued immortal who uses their charm and the irresistible urge to gamble with chance to toy with their target. While we were casting Djain, we provided the voice actors with a cheat sheet—a mix of references that spoke to their chaotic, theatrical energy. Some of our favorites included The Devil from The Imaginarium of Doctor Parnassus, the Grinch, Gambit from X-Men, and Two-Face from the DC Batman universe.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/8d791fd09ad44a89edc2468a23281f534f199c53.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/de16c9591f52e85f06041a0d625a96e268c1796b.png"]

Through these reference points, we landed on who Djain is today: a devilish Starthing who can flip from silky to sinister in a heartbeat.


Djain's Addiction
While most Champions operate with careful planning, Djain leans into their lucky side. They are the master of their universe, creating and solving their problems exactly when and how they need it. A ranged Champion with plenty of utility, Djain is excellent at everything you could need. When luck is on Djain's side—when the stars truly align—the momentum of the fight shifts and suddenly, they're ahead of the game. And when it's not? Well, that's when a true gambler shows how good they really are.

Djain isn't for everyone, but their unpredictability makes them interesting to play if you thrive in that environment. If you're a player who prefers control, predictability, and an airtight strategy, Djain might test your patience. However, if you thrive in chaos, love thinking on your feet, and prefer high-risk/high-reward moments, Djain may be perfect for you.

Each of Djain's three outcomes are powerful in the right hands, and mastering them means not just hoping for the best, but knowing exactly what to do when things are not going your way. The best Djain players are those who can turn uncertainty into pressure.

Now it's your turn. Will you draw a card? Or do you prefer to roll the dice? Either way... give the devil their due when they make you question all the rules.


Looking Forward
We can't wait to see what clutch plays you have up your sleeve with Djain on the field. There's nothing better than experiencing that rush when Lady Luck is on your side, and Djain enables you to have those moments. When the gamble pays off and you rapidly close out a game or flip a team fight? That's the best feeling there is.



May the Glass break your way.


- Kristen C, Community Manager 🌿

notes.title: Glassbreakers Open Beta Wraps Up January 8
notes.content:
To our Glassbreakers Community, 

Thank you for joining us in the Glassbreakers Open Beta on Steam! Your support, feedback, and enthusiasm have been the driving force behind Glassbreakers’ evolution! As we bid farewell to 2023, we also close the Open Beta phase of development as we set our sights on the exciting future ahead… launch!

On January 8, 2024, at 11:59 pm PST, the servers will go offline as we transition into the next phase of Glassbreakers development. But fear not, because this isn't goodbye; it's see you later.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/082a8cd53ef2f06810b47f06d53cb33133ecd9d3.png
A Special Thank You Gift 
To express our gratitude for your unwavering support, we wanted to gift you a little something special for the holidays. Starting today until January 8, 2024, use the promo code "XMoss23" to receive 100,000 Gems to unlock a treasure trove of Champions, masks, dyes, banners, and crests. Note: You may need to restart your game after redeeming.

But the gifts don't end there. As a token of our appreciation, everyone who has played during the Open Beta will receive a Founder's Pack that unlocks an exclusive selection of Glassbreakers cosmetics at launch. And here's the cherry on top – all Glassbreakers Open Beta players will receive the game for free upon its official release. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/8a7c3bcd961e3e05aae7c53ff0909325331cd1e8.png
What Happens Next?
Jump in and play Glassbreakers before servers go offline! Gather up your thoughts and deepest desires and SUBMIT YOUR FINAL FEEDBACK IN OUR PLAYER SURVEY. The last day to submit your survey responses is Jan 12, 2024. 

Following the official closing of our Glassbreakers Open Beta, our development team will focus on refining the game loop and feature set, as well as polishing every detail to deliver the premium experience you’ve come to expect from Polyarc. We're genuinely thrilled about the path moving forward, and we’ll be jumping online during designated windows to play and celebrate the Open Beta wrap-up with you!

Lastly, whether you’re actively playing through early development or patiently waiting for the launch, please 🌟Wishlist Glassbreakers🌟 here on Steam to support our development and keep up to date on the latest news and updates!

For those eager to be part of the ongoing journey, we may leverage our Discord community to test new features as they come online between now and launch. Join our Discord for private playtesting opportunities. 

Thank you for being a crucial part of the Glassbreakers community. Here's to the memories we've made and the adventures still to come.

Happy Holidays, 

Polyarc and the Glassbreakers team

notes.title: Glassbreakers | Open Beta Patch 0.6
notes.content:
Hello Glassbreakers!

We have made the following changes:

New Features
Lobby Tutorial
We’ve added some tutorial features to help new players navigate around the Attic. Let us know what you think in the Glassbreakers Discord!

Bug Fixes

 We have resolved an issue for the Daily Quest Countdown timer displaying the wrong time depending on when and where you complete a quest.
 We have resolved an issue where the Daily Quest for breaking Glass only credits for two when breaking all three in an AI match.
 (Steam) We have resolved an issue impacting in-app purchasing.
 We have resolved an issue impacting Champion stats not appearing correct at the end of matches.

notes.title: Glassbreakers | Open Beta Patch 0.5
notes.content:
Hello Glassbreakers!

We have made the following changes:

Balance Changes
Champions
Gwendoline
While Gwendoline has great survivability on her own, we're not seeing her ability have as much of an impact as we hoped it would. We're increasing both her starting redirection amount and the amount she redirects at max level. Our hope is this gives her team a bit more lasting power in team fights.

Significantly increased the amount of damage redirected from allies while King's Protection is active.

Barnard
Last balance patch we increased Barnard's starting health to give him better survivability in the early game. We knew we needed to do more to make him feel like he can compete with Brel but needed more time to find the right change. In the end we found that both Radiant Blast and Barnard's attack needed a bit of love. Our hope is that these increases in damage will help Barnard compete with Brel for a spot when you are composing your squad.

Slightly increased starting attack damage.
Slightly increased attack damage gained per level.
Increased Radiant Blast's starting damage and damage gained per level.


Bug Fixes


 Players should no longer have the wrong name highlighted on the Leaderboard if you have a tied score.
 Steam players should no longer be offset.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/2fbd7a6532a739f9b97734f343715c4b57d2d1ad.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/5757dcef21c3edd44a96d9c6a0d7563ac7bc2f9c.png
New Features and Improvements

Leaderboards Are Here
Player Ranks are on the way, but in the mean time we are bringing leaderboards to Glassbreakers! You can now see how you stack up against other players. To access the Leaderboard, open the System Menu while in the Attic.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/e2f69ca26fea5b90ac8f9c93c04421979159b530.png
Smarter AI
In this update, Skynet is taking over! One of the most requested features is more engaging matches with our AI. While we still have a lot of work to do, our first improvements are going into this update. The AI will now have profiles: for newer players, the starting AI will not get harder, while for more advanced players, the AI should no longer allow you to simply walk right into their base and get their Glass.
Along with this change, we have reduced the time it takes for idle Champions to attack nearby enemy targets. Overall we have found this makes the game feel smoother in several areas.
Quests
In their current state, quests can feel a little confusing. We wanted to have a concept for “normal” and “hard” quests but this is not coming across as well as we hoped. For now, we are going to pare down the quests to provide more consistency. Look for more, exciting quests being implemented in the future!

Bug Fixes

Fixed an issue where Default Dye was not being applied properly in the Lobby.

notes.title: The Glassbreakers Open Beta is LIVE on Steam VR!
notes.content:
Dear readers, adventurers of Moss, and VR enthusiasts—we're thrilled to announce the Glassbreakers Open Beta is now live on Steam VR!

Our dedicated team has been hard at work to bring Glassbreakers to the Steam platform and couldn’t be more excited to share the next phase of Glassbreakers with you. Starting today, we’ve lifted the player cap so Steam players with SteamVR-compatible headsets, including Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest Pro, Rift, Index, and HTC Vive, can now download and dive into the heart-pounding action of the Glassbreakers Open Beta. The best news? Both Steam and App Lab players can battle against each other thanks to crossplay!

Important Notes

Crossplay is on. You’ll be playing with Glassbreakers players across all supported devices.  
Account linking isn't implemented YET, but rest assured it’s on our roadmap! This means Meta players are unable to transfer their progress to Steam and vice versa. Stay tuned. 
Speaking of development roadmaps, exciting updates are on the horizon! Check out the roadmap to get a sneak peek of what we're currently working on!


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/3f30cf24d5e65e01a8fae604445e2ff0e39604ff.png

We want to extend our heartfelt thanks and give a shoutout to our dedicated community, whose support has been instrumental in shaping Glassbreakers into an exceptional, first-of-its-kind experience in VR. Your feedback and enthusiasm have been the wind beneath our wings, and we're excited to continue this journey together. 🥂

We Want to Hear From You!

We’re listening and prioritizing our development schedule to reflect your input and we can’t wait to bring even more exciting content your way leading up to and with the release of Season 1. In the meantime, we’d love to hear from you, so please leave us a comment, review, or join our active Glassbreakers community on Discord!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44566656/1677a58cee067ee853dba892341eb70423b08d1d.png

Remember, luck favors the brave, and may the Glass break your way! 🌟🛡️🔮🗡️
